assumptions.choice: size = (broker.getvalue() * 0.01) / current close price, recomputed at each entry signal
assumptions.reason: Spec states 'fixed percentage of total trading capital (1% per trade)' but does not give a formula; this is the standard literal reading of allocating 1% of current portfolio value to the position notional.

assumptions.choice: 20-bar SMA of volume must exceed 1,000,000 shares
assumptions.reason: Spec says to ignore signals when volume over the last N=20 candles does not exceed 'a specified threshold' but never states the threshold or whether it's a sum or average; chose an average-volume floor as a reasonable, declared liquidity gate.

assumptions.choice: Implemented as native OCO bracket orders (bt.Order.Stop and bt.Order.Limit) placed at entry via buy_bracket/sell_bracket, evaluated intrabar against High/Low, in addition to the bar-close signal-based exits (BB mid crossover, RSI extremes) checked each bar; whichever exit condition fires first closes the position
assumptions.reason: The spec's imperative language ('set a stop-loss', 'set the take-profit') most literally maps to real broker orders rather than a manual close-price check; the signal-based exits are separate stated conditions and are monitored independently each bar.

assumptions.topic: standard deviation used for stop-loss distance
assumptions.choice: Added a separate raw bt.indicators.StandardDeviation(period=20) (1x, unscaled) distinct from the Bollinger Bands' internal devfactor=2 stddev, and used it as stop_distance = 1.5 * stddev
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly asks for '1.5 standard deviations', which is a different quantity than 1.5x the BB band half-width (which would be 3x raw stddev if reusing the BB-scaled value).

assumptions.choice: Take-profit price is fixed at the Bollinger middle band value observed at the moment of entry (not the moving current mid line)
assumptions.reason: Spec phrases both stop-loss and take-profit as distances/levels 'from the entry point', implying a price level fixed at entry time, mirrored from the stop-loss wording.

assumptions.topic: 'price crosses its middle line' exit signal
assumptions.choice: Implemented via bt.indicators.CrossOver(close, bb.mid), evaluated every bar the position is open, independent of the fixed take-profit order
assumptions.reason: This is a separate stated exit condition from the take-profit rule and uses the current (moving) mid line rather than a fixed entry-time value, per its literal wording.

assumptions.choice: Applied only when evaluating new entry signals, not to exit logic
assumptions.reason: Spec ties the volume/liquidity rule explicitly to 'avoid entering positions in illiquid assets', so exits remain unrestricted to allow risk management to function regardless of liquidity.
